gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed newly-diagnosed WHO grade IV glioblastoma with at least one measurable lesion on MRI.

candidate_evidence.quote: 10 mg thiotepa once weekly for 6 consecutive weeks, beginning within 7 days of the first RT fraction.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM)

role_evidence.quote: preventive thiotepa injections within 1 week of starting radiotherapy, repeated every 7 days for 6 doses.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Thiotepa is a lipophilic alkylating agent that achieves high CSF concentrations
arms: Stupp plus intrathecal injection of thiotepa

role_evidence.quote: Oral temozolomide 75 mg/m² daily, starting on the first day of RT and continuing until the last fraction (≈ 42-49 days).

arms: Stupp plus intrathecal injection of thiotepa

source_quote.quote: adults with newly diagnosed, WHO grade 4 IDH-wildtype glioblastoma who are at very high risk of leptomeningeal seeding

coder_notes: Thiotepa is the only investigational agent, added to the Stupp backbone (regimen combination, role experimental_monotherapy per C1). Intrathecal route coded new_route. IDH-wildtype appears in the detailed description's population statement (not in the inclusion list); coded as a diagnostic eligibility biomarker, never candidate-matched. SVZ contact / ventricular entry are imaging or surgical risk criteria, not molecular biomarkers. CSF/blood samples are for unspecified exploratory biomarkers, not linked to thiotepa, so no target engagement or PK.
